description: Attribute, event, and purchase uploads to the Braze /users/track endpoint.

params.name: external_id
params.description: Braze documents one of external_id, user_alias, braze_id, email, or phone as required on every object.

params.name: user_alias
params.description: Braze documents one of external_id, user_alias, braze_id, email, or phone as required on every object.

params.name: braze_id
params.description: Braze documents one of external_id, user_alias, braze_id, email, or phone as required on every object.

params.name: email
params.description: Braze documents one of external_id, user_alias, braze_id, email, or phone as required on every object.

params.name: phone
params.description: Braze documents one of external_id, user_alias, braze_id, email, or phone as required on every object.

params.name: app_id
params.description: It is the App Identifier. Braze documents it as optional on events.
params.fix_hint: Send `app_id` as the App Identifier from Braze, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: user_alias.alias_name
params.description: It is the alias identifier. Braze documents it as required on a user alias object, at most 236 bytes.
params.fix_hint: Set `user_alias.alias_name` to a non-empty identifier of at most 236 bytes.

params.name: user_alias.alias_label
params.description: It is the alias type. Braze documents it as required on a user alias object, at most 236 bytes.
params.fix_hint: Set `user_alias.alias_label` to a non-empty label of at most 236 bytes.

params.name: name
params.description: Braze documents the event name as required.
params.fix_hint: Name the custom event.

params.name: time
params.description: Braze documents the event time as an ISO 8601 datetime, such as `2026-07-26T06:00:00+00:00`.
params.fix_hint: Send an ISO 8601 datetime rather than an epoch number.

params.name: _update_existing_only
params.description: Braze documents this as a boolean. When true, the call updates an existing profile and does not create one.

params.name: properties.time
params.description: Braze reserves `time` as an event field, not as a custom property name.
params.fix_hint: Rename the property. `time` is reserved.

params.name: properties.event_name
params.description: Braze reserves `event_name` and cannot use it as a custom property.
params.fix_hint: Rename the property. `event_name` is reserved.

rules.message: The event carries more than one primary identifier. Braze documents one of `external_id`, `user_alias`, or `braze_id` per object, and rejects the object when two are sent.
rules.fix_hint: Send one primary identifier. `email` and `phone` may ride alongside it as attributes.

rules.message: The object carries none of `external_id`, `user_alias`, `braze_id`, `email`, or `phone`. Braze documents one of them as required, and cannot attach the data to a user without one.
rules.fix_hint: Add one of the documented identifiers to the object.

rules.message: A `user_alias` object is missing `alias_name` or `alias_label`. Braze documents both as required, each at most 236 bytes.

params.name: currency
params.description: Braze documents the currency as required on a purchase, as an ISO 4217 code.

params.name: price
params.description: Braze documents the price as a float in the currency's base unit, such as dollars for USD.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `129.99`, with no currency symbol.

params.name: quantity
params.description: Braze documents quantity as an integer from 1 through 100, defaulting to 1.
params.fix_hint: Send an integer from 1 to 100.
